reviews.title: Awesome bang for buck
reviews.comment: Works excellent, replaced an old HDD with this item, fits excellent in a small form factor case, I am now able to run latest programs and games with this SSD it is extremely fast for the price. 10/10.
reviews.author: Caleb skipper

reviews.title: Fast, reliable, and easy upgrade
reviews.comment: The PNY CS900 250GB SSD is a solid upgrade for my laptop. Installation was straightforward, and the SATA III interface delivers noticeable speed improvements over a standard HDD. Boot times and app loading are much faster, and the 3D NAND ensures reliable performance. The 250GB capacity is good for OS and essential programs. A cost-effective way to boost system performance.
reviews.author: M. Kelly

reviews.title: Very good entry level pc ssd
reviews.comment: For the price it doesn’t really get better then this i paid i think 20$ and used it in a spare pc I actually purchased 2 and both run absolutely perfect super easy just plug in and your down no errors or crashes and not the worst storage size would recommend for entry level pcs
reviews.author: Travis Conrad

reviews.title: Great drive, boots quick
reviews.comment: Ordered this ssd to replace my old PNY drive to be my new boot drive. Drive functions as it should, was able to format to gpt with no issues. Boots quick and based on my last PNY drive, should be very reliable.
reviews.author: David

reviews.title: low priced SSD  -Great for testing new operating systems. older PC's supposedly not W11 capable
reviews.comment: Great price, easy installation, seems to work OK with W11.  Will test on Linux mint.  Not sure about reliability- had an older one, that didn't last very long, so will see.  Happy for now.  Works OK for linux- Mint and Zorin seem to work well with this drive.
reviews.author: WaryWayfarer
